name: R1 EDU U5
summary: Unitree R1 EDU U5: EDU configuration with two BrainCo Revo 2 Basic five-finger hands (reichelt). R1 EDU platform per Unitree: about 1.23 m; 6 DoF per leg, 5 per arm, 2 waist and 2 head, with a total of 26-40 DoF depending on configuration; binocular camera, 4-mic array and speaker, about 1 h battery life, secondary development supported, 12-month warranty. 38 DoF in total for this configuration. Sources: unitree.com/R1 and reichelt.com, agent-retrieved 2026-09-11.
specs_note: RETRIEVAL: AGENT_ASSISTED_RESEARCH (docs/26) — retrieved 2026-09-11 by Claude Opus 5 (curl + WebFetch) in a session initiated by Robert Konecny for European Catalogue Gap Batch 01B, under research work order 'OWNER WORK ORDER — BATCH 01B COMMERCIAL RESEARCH' (2026-09-11; docs/26 §2.1). Not a MANUAL_BOOTSTRAP reading. Not human-verified. height_cm 123.0 from Unitree's R1 table ('Height, Width and Thickness（Stand） 1230x357x190mm', R1 EDU column). payload_kg UNKNOWN (owner decision, 2026-09-11): Unitree's row reads 'Maximum Torque of Arm Joint【1】 About 2kg' — labelled as torque but expressed in kg, with footnote 【1】 on 'the maximum load of the arm' — so the source wording is internally inconsistent and no payload is recorded. runtime_minutes 60 from 'Battery Life About 1h'. has_vision: 'Binocular camera'. has_language_ui: the R1 page states 'Integrated with a Large Multimodal Model for voice and images' plus a 4-mic array and speaker — a series-level marketing claim, and footnote [7] warns some sample functions are still being developed, so MEDIUM. has_sdk / developer_edition: 'Secondary Development【2】 YES' for R1 EDU only. has_api: 'Fully open control interfaces for joints and sensors' (R1 page) and reichelt's 'high- and low-level programming'. simulation_support: R1 page 'support for mainstream simulation platforms'; reichelt 'support for simulations (e.g., Isaac SIM)'. Compute (no catalogue field): Unitree lists the High-Power Computing Module for R1 EDU as 'Multiple brands and models available such as Orin(40-100TOPS)'. Edition identity: the U1–U6 codes are distributor configuration codes (reichelt 'Man. part no.'); Unitree's own page names only 'R1 EDU' (26-40 DoF, 'Dexterous Hand: Optional') and publishes no U-code table, so model_code stays NULL. ros_support, autonomy, walk_speed, battery_wh, reach and arm span are not stated by any fresh primary source and stay UNKNOWN. weight_kg left UNKNOWN: Unitree's 'About 29kg' R1 EDU figure does not say whether dexterous hands are included, and reichelt's '25000 g' / '40 kg' rows conflict with it and with each other. hand_dof 6 is the ACTIVE / actuated count — the catalogue convention for hand_dof (owner decision, 2026-09-11): BrainCo's Revo 2 parameter page (brainco-hz.com) states '6 active joints' with a 'total of 11 degrees of freedom' (5 passive). degrees_of_freedom 38 = 26 body joints + 2 × 6 active, matching reichelt's 'DOF: 38' and staying inside Unitree's R1 EDU range of '26-40'. reichelt: 'two Revo 2 Basic five-finger hands'. BrainCo: the Basic version has no tactile module.

capabilities.detail: Unitree's R1 page states the platform is 'Integrated with a Large Multimodal Model for voice and images', with a 4-microphone array and speaker. Stated for the R1 line, with a footnote that some sample functions are still in development.
Two BrainCo Revo 2 Basic five-finger hands. BrainCo states 6 active joints and 11 total degrees of freedom per hand; the catalogue counts ACTIVE joints.
